en.title: PegCanvas — Turn any picture into a pegboard wall
en.description: PegCanvas turns illustrations, photos and logos into modular multi-color pegboards right in your browser, and exports a 3MF ready for your 3D printer.
en.heroBadge: First prints done. Kickstarter coming soon.
en.heroH1: Turn any picture into a wall you use.
en.heroCopy: Upload an illustration, photo or logo. PegCanvas turns it into modular, multi-color pegboards right in your browser and exports a 3MF ready for your 3D printer.
en.check2: Your images stay in your browser
en.splitOpen: Take it apart: one image, four panels
en.inspTitle:
A storage wall
that doubles as art.
en.s0Body: A botanical design flows across several panels, with room for keys, hats and small plants.
en.s0Alt: AI concept: entryway wall with a botanical design spanning several pegboards
en.s1Body: Warm geometric shapes become a full wall piece. It looks like art and still works as a pegboard.
en.s1Alt: AI concept: warm geometric pegboard wall art above a living-room sofa
en.s2Body: A full fantasy mural behind your setup. Hang the headset, controller and figures right on it and keep the desk clear.
en.s2Alt: AI concept: fantasy-illustration pegboard wall above a gaming desk, holding a headset and controller
en.s3Body: A race track becomes the wall itself, with toys and tracks hanging right beside it.
en.s3Alt: AI concept: race-track themed pegboard wall in a kids room
en.sloganH2:
Why choose plain
when you can make it fun?
en.howTitle: Three steps from picture to wall.
en.h0Body: PNG, JPEG or SVG. Compare 4 to 16-color versions and confirm before it goes on the canvas.
en.h1Body: Set the panel size and add panels in any direction. Scale and rotate layers, and color each panel your way.
en.h2Body: One multi-material 3MF with a plate per panel. Open it in your slicer and print.
en.colorNote: The strip shows the filament colors used at this color count. Nothing goes on the canvas until you confirm, and your original is kept.
en.sizeNote: Anywhere from 100 to 340 mm to fit your printer. Add panels in any direction to build a full wall.
en.exportNote: One plate per panel. Open it in your slicer and print.
en.specTitle:
You bring the idea.
We handle sizes and holes.
en.sp1Body: Adjust the design depth; the base fills the rest.
en.sp2Body: One global hole grid, aligned across every panel.
en.sp3Body: Adjustable or off. Screws sit flush on the wall.
en.sp4Body: Scale, rotate and stack layers, with colors per panel.
en.pricingTitle:
Every feature included.
Pay for commercial rights.
en.pricingCopy: All paid plans have the same design features. One-time purchase, no subscription, and every future update to the web app is included.
en.freeList:
• Up to 2 panels per project
  • Up to 3 image layers
  • Up to 4 colors
  • Unlimited 3MF exports
  • Non-commercial use only
en.personalList:
• Unlimited panels, layers and colors
  • Cross-panel designs and large walls
  • One-time purchase, free updates
  • Personal, non-commercial use
en.commercialList:
• Everything in Personal
  • Sell pegboards you print
  • Design and print custom orders
  • Does not include selling digital files
en.studioList:
• Everything in Commercial
  • Sell and deliver 3MF/STL files
  • Run a custom digital model service
  • 3 seats
en.licenseNote: Licenses cover your use of PegCanvas output. You are responsible for rights to any images, characters or brand assets you use.
en.q1: Do I need to install anything or sign up?
en.a1: No install. Design, preview and download in your browser; images are processed locally and never uploaded. The current preview needs no login. The full release uses one-click Google sign-in, with no separate account to create.
en.a2: An FDM printer that supports multi-material printing, and a slicer that opens 3MF files. Match colors to the filament you already have.
en.a3: Each panel can be 100–340 mm in 20 mm steps, sized to your print bed. Tile panels in any direction to cover a whole wall.
en.q4: Will I have to pay again later?
en.a4: No. It is a one-time purchase with no subscription, and every future update to the web app is included, so you always have the latest version. If we ever shut down the online service, we will provide an offline version so you can keep using it.
en.ctaCopy: Email us to be first in line when we launch, and don’t miss early-bird pricing.
en.ownership: A product of BABYGLIDER ONLINE STORE · Philippines

zh.title: PegCanvas — 把喜歡的圖，印成會用的牆
zh.description: PegCanvas 在瀏覽器裡把插畫、照片或 Logo 轉成可拼接的多色洞洞板，直接輸出 3MF 交給你的 3D 印表機。
zh.heroBadge: 首件實印完成，眾籌準備中
zh.heroH1:
把喜歡的圖，
印成會用的牆。
zh.heroCopy: 上傳插畫、照片或 Logo，PegCanvas 在瀏覽器裡把它轉成可拼接的多色洞洞板，直接輸出 3MF 交給你的 3D 印表機。
zh.check1: 免安裝，打開瀏覽器就能用
zh.check2: 圖片不離開你的瀏覽器
zh.splitOpen: 拆開看看：一張圖，四塊板
zh.inspTitle:
實用的收納牆，
也是你的畫布。
zh.aiLabel: AI 概念示意 · 非實拍
zh.s0Body: 植物圖案跨過多塊板件連成一片，鑰匙、帽子和小盆栽都有地方掛。
zh.s0Alt: AI 概念示意：玄關牆面上以植物圖案串聯的多塊洞洞板
zh.s1Title: 安靜的角落，多一點顏色。
zh.s1Body: 暖色幾何拼成一整面壁飾，看起來是藝術品，用起來還是洞洞板。
zh.s1Alt: AI 概念示意：客廳沙發上方的暖色幾何洞洞板壁飾
zh.s2Title: 收藏的舞台，也是牆上的畫。
zh.s2Body: 整面奇幻插畫當背景，耳機、手把和公仔直接掛上去，桌面清爽，牆面有戲。
zh.s2Alt: AI 概念示意：電競桌上方以奇幻插畫拼成的整面洞洞板，掛著耳機與手把
zh.s3Body: 賽道圖案直接變成牆面，玩具和軌道就掛在圖案旁邊。
zh.s3Alt: AI 概念示意：兒童房的賽車主題洞洞板牆
zh.sloganH2:
既然可以更有趣，
為什麼還要選擇平凡？
zh.h0Body: PNG、JPEG、SVG 都可以。先比較 4 到 16 色的分色效果，確認後才放上畫布。
zh.h1Body: 自訂板件尺寸，四個方向加板；圖層自由縮放、旋轉，每塊板各自配色。
zh.h2Body: 一個多材料 3MF，每塊板一個盤，打開切片軟體就能印。
zh.colorNote: 色條是這個色數會用到的耗材顏色。確認之後才放上畫布，原圖保留。
zh.sizeNote: 100–340 mm，依你的印表機大小選擇；四個方向都能加板，拼成整面牆。
zh.fileMeta: 4 盤 · 多材料 · 組裝資訊已內嵌
zh.exportNote: 每塊板一個盤，打開切片軟體就能直接印。
zh.specTitle:
你負責創意，
尺寸和孔位交給我們。
zh.sp1Body: 圖案厚度可調，底板自動補足。
zh.sp2Body: 全域孔位，跨板也對得齊。
zh.sp3Body: 可調整或關閉，鎖上牆面平整齊平。
zh.sp4Body: 縮放、旋轉、排序，每塊板各自配色。
zh.pricingTitle:
功能全都給你，
只為商用付費。
zh.pricingCopy: 付費方案的設計功能完全相同。一次買斷、沒有訂閱，之後的網頁版更新全部包含。
zh.pricingBadge: 眾籌預定價 · 美元 · 暫定
zh.freeList:
• 每個作品最多 2 片板
  • 最多 3 個圖片圖層
  • 最多 4 色
  • 3MF 匯出不限次數
  • 僅限非商業使用
zh.personalList:
• 板件、圖層、顏色全部不限
  • 跨板圖案與大型拼接牆
  • 一次買斷，更新全部免費
  • 個人、非商業使用
zh.commercialList:
• Personal 全部功能
  • 販售自己列印的實體洞洞板
  • 接客戶訂製，設計並列印
  • 不含販售數位檔案
zh.studioSub: 工作室與數位商品賣家
zh.studioList:
• Commercial 全部權利
  • 販售、交付 3MF／STL 數位檔
  • 經營數位模型訂製服務
  • 3 個使用席位
zh.licenseNote: 授權範圍是 PegCanvas 輸出檔案的使用權；你使用的圖片、角色或品牌素材，需自行取得授權。
zh.q1: 需要安裝軟體或註冊嗎？
zh.a1: 不用安裝，打開瀏覽器就能設計、預覽與下載，圖片在你的瀏覽器裡處理，不會上傳。目前的試用版免登入；正式版使用 Google 帳號一鍵登入，不用另外註冊。
zh.q2: 我需要什麼樣的 3D 印表機？
zh.a2: 支援多材料列印的 FDM 印表機，以及能開啟 3MF 的切片軟體。耗材顏色可以照你手邊有的來配。
zh.a3: 單塊板可在 100–340 mm 之間以 20 mm 為單位調整，依你的印表機成型尺寸選擇，再往四個方向拼接成一整面牆。
zh.a4: 不用。一次買斷、沒有訂閱，網頁版之後的更新都包含在內，你永遠用的是最新版。若日後停止線上服務，我們會提供離線版本，讓你繼續使用。
zh.ctaCopy: 寫信給我們登記，開跑時第一個通知你，早鳥方案不錯過。
